verdict.rationale: Entra documents device-based Conditional Access policies built on registered or joined device identities (docs-8, docs-22). Conditional Access is the policy engine that gates access to apps like Microsoft 365 (docs-2, docs-16), so device checks before an app session are a documented first-party capability. However, the specific posture attributes (managed, encrypted, screen-locked) are never shown being evaluated. The evidence ties MDM to the separate Intune product, so the depth of posture checking within Entra itself is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of compliance or posture conditions (encryption, screen lock) in Conditional Access, clarity on whether posture evaluation needs Intune, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
